summary: Zeta Network Group furnished a Form 6-K to provide six-month unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended December 31, 2025, and to incorporate them into existing registration statements on Form S-8 and F-3. The report includes balance sheets, statements of operations, and an operating review. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, shareholder votes, or structural changes are present. This is not a special situation.
